outcome: Accuracy of ultrasonography in evaluating lesion size and infiltration depth
cohort: 151 AWE patients treated at Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital, Fudan University from 2003 to 2010
finding: The study found no correlation between previous cesarean section factors and the onset of abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE), but did find that lesion morphology may be correlated with disease severity and that postoperative medication might reduce recurrence.
